User.title: User
User.description: User profile, study statistics, daily study logs, mock tests, and recent scans keyed by normalized Email ID.

Mistake.title: Mistake
Mistake.description: Mistake recorded from mock tests or chapter quizzes for mastery review under the user's email ID.

StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: Generated or saved study revision note stored under the user's email ID.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Chat prompt history item from AI Tutor stored under the user's email ID.

PlannerSchedule.title: PlannerSchedule
PlannerSchedule.description: Student master timetable and exam dates configuration stored under the user's email ID.

StudyReminder.title: StudyReminder
StudyReminder.description: Custom or preset study reminder notification scheduled by a student under their email ID.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles, study stats, mock test history, reminders, and daily study logs keyed by email ID.

/users/{userId}/mistakes/{mistakeId}.description: Stores mistake records for the student Mistake Book per email ID.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores saved notes for the student per email ID.

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{msgId}.description: Stores AI Tutor prompts history per email ID.

/users/{userId}/planner/{plannerId}.description: Stores exam schedule and timetable per email ID.

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Stores study reminders per email ID.
